title: horkelia bolanderi subsp. clevelandii
intro: Horkelia bolanderi subsp. clevelandii, commonly known as Cleveland's horkelia, is a rare and endangered plant species native to California, USA. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Horkelia bolanderi subsp. clevelandii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
